name: AWS F2 published HBM2 geometry/timing with generic Ramulator controller
clock_quantization: Ramulator stores integer picoseconds: 1111ps vs nominal 10000/9ps (about 100ppm faster)
unmodeled: AMD proprietary controller scheduling, physical address mapping, AXI crossbar and CDC delays
Finite FPGA DMA resources and AXI port backpressure
ECC/data parity behavior and physical HBM PHY/calibration
Closed-loop accelerator stalls and non-GEMM execution

assumptions.controller: HBM12 with FRFCFS, open-page, all-bank refresh; 32-entry read/write buffers
assumptions.latency_mapping: USER_RL=22 -> nCL=22 and USER_WL=7 -> nCWL=7 are interpreted as decoded cycle latencies; the XCI-to-mode-register encoding has not been independently verified
assumptions.address_layout: 32-byte striping across physical channels; native RoBaRaCoCh within channel
assumptions.bank_geometry: 2 SID x 4 bank groups x 4 banks x 16384 rows per pseudochannel
